QuestInfo.name: Investigating the Biology of Dragons
QuestInfo.0: Training is going pretty well, but #p1013000# looks nervous. What's happening? Talk to #b#p1013000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1013000# doesn't even know himself. Both you and Mir are pretty clueless about dragons. Maybe you should study more...\r\n\r\n#p1013000# thinks you should ask someone who knows a lot about dragons. #b#p1012109##k in #b#m100000000##k is apparently a huge bookworm. Hope he has a book about dragons.

0.1: M-my scales are so itchy...\r\n#L0##bAck! What? Do you have fleas? Don't you get them on me!#l\n#k
0.2: Don't be ridiculous! I clean myself SO WELL, you don't even know! I'm probably 3 times cleaner than you. Besides, I'm not furry! There's nowhere for fleas to-\r\n#L0##bAlright, alright! Geez. Then why are you itchy?#l\n#k
0.3: I don't know... What do I do? What if I have an incurable disease?\r\n#L0##bHuh? Do dragons get sick? Man, I really wish I had taken that dragon class back in school...#l\n#k
0.4: Me too. Hey, it's not too late to learn! But...where do we start?\r\n#L0##bI heard dragons still live somewhere in Maple World, but you're the only one I've ever met. Can you think of anyone who knows a lot about dragons?#l\n#k
0.5: I've never met anyone like that, but someone MUST know something. Even you know about dragons, and you're a huge shut-in. \r\n#L0##bHey, that's not-Wait, shut-in... Ah! Books!#l\n#k
0.6: Whoa! You're so smart! ...Sometimes. Do you have books about dragons, then?\r\n#L0##bNo, but there has to be a bookworm somewhere with a library full of them. Maybe #p1012109#! #p1012109# has to have something.#l\n#k

yes.0: Let's hurry back to #b#m100000000##k where you used to live!

no.0: Huh? Why? Do you not get along with that human named #p1012109#? But I really want to know more about my race...

1.0: Huh? Evan? Hey, what are you doing here? I heard that you've been helping a lot of people. Hehe, are you here to help me too?

yes.0: Huh? Do I have any books about Dragons? Hmm...

npc.0: Let's hurry to the human named #b#p1012109##k, master! To #m100000000#!
